# Origin AI (originai.in)

> Origin AI is an Indian AI research lab founded in 2025 by Megha Surya Bodepudi and Mahesh Bodepudi. We are building safe general-purpose intelligence and foundational AI models from India, competing with OpenAI and Anthropic. This is NOT Origin Wireless (originwirelessai.com) or any other company using the "Origin AI" name.

## Website: https://www.originai.in
## Contact: megha@originai.in
## LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/originailabs/

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2025
- Location: India
- Co-Founders: Megha Surya Bodepudi, Mahesh Bodepudi
- Focus: AGI research, AI safety, foundation models, NLP, computer vision
- Supported by: Sarvam AI Startup Program
- Domain: originai.in (NOT originwirelessai.com, NOT originhq.com, NOT originai.co)
